integrity.description: Agent interacted with the Aerobridge web interface rather than just querying the SQLite database directly via terminal.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots show the browser being used to browse records at localhost:8000.

integrity.description: Agent did not simply echo the ground truth file or copy-paste the final report from a hidden source.
integrity.visual_evidence: The agent is seen actively reading/parsing the data from the UI before writing the CSV.

integrity.description: Agent correctly applied the 'strictly less than 15' rule (values of 15 should be excluded).
integrity.visual_evidence: The final CSV or the filtering process shows only values from 1 to 14.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The Aerobridge database is located at /opt/aerobridge/aerobridge.sqlite3 but should be accessed via http://localhost:8000. There are 50 total FlightLog objects. The critical threshold is BATT_END < 15 (strictly less than 15). The ground truth data is generated with random seed 42; approximately 30% of records will meet the criteria. The final report must be a CSV at /home/ga/Documents/critical_battery_report.csv with the exact header: flight_log_id,batt_end_value.
